recommended_static.name: Tuned MLFQ
recommended_static.scope: simulator baseline only; not a real-Linux scheduler performance claim

decision: Do not promote v6. Its independently retuned static parameters confound guard attribution; the fresh v6 model regresses versus v5 and the previous frozen static response envelope. Guard-only ablation improves response modestly but sacrifices score. Retain v5 for research and the prior tuned static baseline for simulator use.
